target: Scheduled-passenger DD/FD certificate revenue passenger miles, in millions, with the preserved four-market WAC crosswalk. Served traffic is an endogenous demand proxy, not unconstrained demand or consolidated UAL traffic.
state_model: Log RPM = carrier-market offset + shared within-market calendar-month effect + local-level state + Gaussian measurement error. Twelve local levels follow a random walk; process innovations correlate across the three carriers in the same market. Initial covariance is identity. Missing/unreleased observations receive no update.
estimation: At each month-end issue date, require every initial 2013-19 observation to be released. A complete market target requires both selected DD and FD scope releases, including scopes with no contributing segments; use the latest of contributor and both scope publication dates. Expand the fit with observations available by that cutoff only. Ridge estimates offsets/market seasonality; conditional innovation likelihood selects process and measurement variances on the declared finite grids, separately for each pooling candidate. No global continuous-MLE claim.
baseline_rule: Persistence uses the most recent released observation in the target calendar month. Fixed mean uses only the initial sample. AR uses log lag 1, log lag 12, carrier-market offsets and market calendar-month effects; it recursively bridges the release gap without target observations.
selection_metric: Lowest equal-weight mean MASE across 48 carrier/market/horizon cells on identical eligible forecasts. Scaling is each series' initial-sample mean absolute lag-12 RPM difference. Deterministic ties use declared pooling order. No locked target access.
uncertainty: Native Gaussian/lognormal predictive intervals conditional on fixed fitted parameters are uncalibrated. No pathwise parameter uncertainty, causal elasticity, pricing response, joint coverage or extreme-shock guarantee.
vintage: Reconstruction from preserved selected archive releases. Respect their actual published_on dates; annual backfills can create long information lags. Intermediate vintages are unavailable, so no historical point-in-time performance claim.
scope: Same-table certificate scheduled-passenger DD/FD traffic. Foreign-to-foreign coverage, consolidated marketed regional flying, fare/yield matching, unconstrained demand and simulator integration remain unresolved. No SEC/Form 41 revenue denominator or synthetic fare target.
